Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, soft dimensional fur and fabric texture, warm brown contours and ivory highlights, match the existing avatar collection. Use balanced gentle lighting so face and green clothing are clear, rather than copying the photograph's deep shadows.
Composition: square canvas, one centered upright head-and-upper-torso bust with a gently rounded lower shoulder silhouette and ample transparent margins. Nearly frontal with the slight source head angle and calm expression. Omit both hands and arms raised toward the wall.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha. Remove the picture frame, mirror/reflection, wall, room, all scenery and all other objects. Only one character, no duplicate reflected face. No background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
